change: Queue equality now uses a per-logical-device identity retained by Queue clones instead of shared Metal backend handles

regression.before: hardware test failed: queues of different logical devices compared equal
regression.after: passed on actual Metal adapter; queue clones stable, device error handlers isolated, identity survives device handle drop

limits: Logical identity fix only; Metal queue/resources remain shared
Error isolation assertion calls logical Device record_error; it is not asynchronous backend error routing qualification
Forwarding non-loss command failures with original submit ownership remains open
Physical device removal, idle notifications and other backends remain unqualified
